body: CHANGELOG updated in emily.cli: fix(promptoverse): vertexGenerateImage now surfaces finishReason/finishMessage instead of a generic 'no image data in response' -- diagnosed a real live failure that looked like a broken API key but was actually Vertex's IMAGE_PROHIBITED_CONTENT filter blocking Rapunzel (Disney IP). New errVertexContentBlocked sentinel: drainQueue skips permanently-blocked items instead of jamming the queue behind them, same treatment as the earlier duplicate-entry fix. (sess-20260813-2154-dda37e8b)
